changeSet.author: jieen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${table.prefix}workdoc_document` ( `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'Primary Key', `document_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Document ID (same as documentId in datasheet cell)', `dst_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Datasheet ID', `field_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Field ID', `record_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Record ID', `title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Document title', `content` mediumblob COMMENT 'Y.js document state (Uint8Array)', `created_by` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Creator user ID', `updated_by` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Last modifier user ID', `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT 'Create time', `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT 'Update time', `is_deleted` tinyint(1) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Delete flag(0:No,1:Yes)', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_document_id` (`document_id`), KEY `idx_dst_field_record` (`dst_id`, `field_id`, `record_id`), KEY `idx_updated_at` (`updated_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='WorkDoc document content storage';
